label: PF Backlog 43
title: Hybrid storage: dashboard control-plane in a DB (SQLite/Postgres); pipeline truths stay file stores
body: Owner decision (P15). Pipeline backend keeps FILE stores (one truth per concern, single writer, 120 registered stores; JSON/JSONL/Markdown) and stays the source of truth (dashboard reads only, acts via core modules). The dashboard's OWN control-plane data - tenants, users, sessions, invitations, per-user/project email + webhook settings, dashboard audit log - lives in a DB owned by ONE dashboard control-plane module: SQLite (self-hosted) / Postgres (multi-tenant SaaS). Register the store(s) in config/store-registry.json. Existing DB precedent: portfolio queue (core/portfolio.py -> product-forge/portfolio/queue.db).
